First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Pace isn’t posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you’re new when you arrive.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the SNH NEMBA Thursday at Yudicky group ride

SNH NEMBA Thursday at Yudicky is a mountain bike group ride in Nashua, NH. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 pm from Yudicky Park.

A weekly mountain bike ride at Yudicky Park, known for tight technical singletrack with ramps and teeter-totters. The focus is skills, exercise and fun.
